title: Targets
text:
By default, triggers such as hover and click only fire when the icon itself is interacted with. The target argument lets another element fire the trigger instead — its value is a CSS selector for an ancestor of the icon.
In the example below the icon sits inside a div with class block, and target=.block makes the whole card clickable. A little extra CSS handles the styling.

text:
Sequence
The sequence trigger chains states, plays, and delays together into a custom scenario defined by the sequence argument. Steps are separated by commas: state:NAME selects an animation, play (or play:reverse) runs it, and delay:MS pauses. The available state names come from the icon’s own markers.







Shortcode
Icon




{{< lif gift_raw.json trigger=sequence sequence="state:hover-squeeze,play,delay:500,state:hover-roll,play,delay:500" >}}

title: Lordicon Extension for Quarto
text: This extension lets you embed animated Lordicon icons in your Quarto HTML documents (including Reveal.js slides). Icons can be pulled from the official CDN or loaded from local .json files, and customized on the fly without editing the source files.

title: Lordicon Extension for Quarto
text: Showcase

title: Lordicon Extension for Quarto
text:
Source
The {{< li >}} shortcode downloads an icon from the Lordicon CDN and renders it by its code — the eight-character identifier in https://cdn.lordicon.com/CODE.json. Lordicon used to hand these out under Export → Embed HTML; the redesigned export UI no longer offers that, so existing codes still resolve but new icons are easier to use via {{< lif >}}.
The {{< lif >}} shortcode renders an icon from a local .json file instead. Download one by opening an icon on lordicon.com, clicking Edit and download, then in the right-hand panel opening the format menu and clicking the options icon next to Lottie.
That options icon offers two Lottie flavors, and which one you want depends on where you plan to customize the icon:

Minified (the default) bakes the editor’s colors and stroke into the shapes and keeps only the animation you picked. Much smaller file, and the right choice when the icon already looks the way you want.
Raw keeps every animation along with the control layer that colors, stroke, and state write into. Choose this to customize per use from the shortcode.







Note



The two approaches don’t combine: colors, stroke, and state have no effect on a minified file, since those values were baked in at export. Either re-export as Raw or set them in the editor and leave the arguments off. The extension prints a warning when it sees that combination.









Shortcode
Rendered




{{< li ibydboev >}}



{{< lif gift_raw.json >}}

Lordicon Extension for Quarto
text:
Accessibility
Icons are decorative by default and hidden from assistive technology (aria-hidden="true"). When an icon carries meaning, pass a label and it is exposed to screen readers with role="img" and that name.
ARIA attributes you pass yourself take precedence. Passing a non-empty aria-hidden, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or role stops the extension from adding aria-hidden="true". With label, your own role or aria-label replaces the one that label adds. These four names count in any letter case, so Role or ARIA-LABEL works the same way. When you set aria-label or aria-labelledby directly, also pass role="img" so screen readers announce the icon.
If an icon gets an image role (img, image, or graphics-symbol) but no name, the render warns. A screen reader then announces an image without saying what it shows. The render reads the first word of role that the ARIA specs define as a role, which is the rule that WAI-ARIA gives browsers. These specs are WAI-ARIA 1.2, DPUB-ARIA 1.1, and Graphics-ARIA 1.0, plus image. So role="bogus img" warns, and role="presentation img" does not. A name comes from label, aria-label, aria-labelledby, or title. If you also pass aria-hidden="true", hidden, or inert, the render does not warn.







Shortcode
Icon




{{< li ibydboev >}} (decorative)



{{< li ibydboev label="Money bag" >}}



{{< li ibydboev role="img" aria-label="Money bag" >}}
